articles.summary: Trio Petroleum’s Canadian unit is paying C$1M in stock for four Saskatchewan heavy oil wells and a disposal facility that it believes can earn up to $100,000 a month.
articles.title: Trio Petroleum Corp. (NYSE American: TPET) Announces Strategic Acquisition of Cash-Flow-Positive Production in Saskatchewan and Highlights Multilateral Opportunities in the North Half of Section 3-48-24W3
